contests.name: Constitutional Amendment A
contests.description: Proposed amendment that removes the requirement to publish proposed constitutional amendments in newspapers in every county for two months before the election. Instead, the Legislature would set how amendments are published, provided the full text is posted on the state public notice website and the Lieutenant Governor's website at least 60 days before the general election.

contests.name: Constitutional Amendment B
contests.description: Proposed amendment requiring a 60 percent vote, rather than a simple majority, for any citizen-initiated ballot measure that creates, changes, or expands a tax, including new taxes, tax rate increases, and certain property tax changes. A simple majority would continue to be enough for other initiatives.
